lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the weight of ancient stone
Where silent kings sit on their throne
The shadows stretch across the land
Carved by the touch of time's own hand
[Pre-Chorus]
The whispers rise like morning mist
By fire and silver light, they're kissed
[Chorus]
Rise above the mountain height
Claim the stars in golden light
Wings of fire, hearts of gold
Stories of the brave, forever told
[Verse]
Across the waves of sapphire blue
The sailors chased a path so true
Through crashing waves and howling gale
They wove the wind into a sail
[Pre-Chorus]
The mountains bow to face the sun
The journey has only just begun
[Chorus]
Rise above the mountain height
Claim the stars in golden light
Wings of fire, hearts of gold
Stories of the brave, forever told
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
In the silence of the deep
Promises the spirit keeps
[Chorus]
Rise above the mountain height
Claim the stars in golden light
Wings of fire, hearts of gold
Stories of the brave, forever told
[Outro]
